description.value: Harvest Community Foods is a community-supported, locally sourced grocery store and noodle soup café in Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood, owned and operated by local chefs Andrea Carlson and Gabriella Meyer. The shop serves a rotating menu of ramen, udon, and rice bowls with multiple vegan options, alongside a grocery section emphasizing urban produce and small-batch local foods. It also functions as a pickup hub for CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) bags filled with seasonal produce sourced from regional farms.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at harvestunion.ca is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (243 Union Street, Vancouver, BC V6A 2B2) and phone number (604.682.8851), confirming this is an active business. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, community-rooted café and grocery store with vegan-friendly hot meals and takeout/delivery options; a practical food stop for touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood.
